Import: `import { Transfer } from "@tundralibs/ui/transfer"`

Rendered in every variant on the catalogue (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/index.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `Transfer`

```ts
Transfer(props: TransferProps): Html
```

Two lists and the buttons between them: pick items on one side, move
them to the other. The form control is a native `<select multiple>`
carrying `name` — what a no-JS page shows and what every page posts;
transfer.js keeps its options' `selected` in step with the chosen list
and fires `change` on it, so `filter.js`, `autosubmit` and a form's
validation see an ordinary multi select. Lists are `role="listbox"`
(`aria-multiselectable`): click or Space marks an item, double-click or
Enter moves it, arrows walk, Home/End jump, Ctrl+A marks every visible
item; the search box above each list filters it. Below 768px the lists
stack and the buttons turn into a row between them.

## Types

### `TransferSize`

Height of each list: sm 12rem, md 16rem, lg 24rem.

- `"sm"`
- `"md"`
- `"lg"`

### `TransferOption`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | yes | What the form posts for this item. |
| `label` | `string | Html` | yes |  |
| `selected` | `boolean` |  | Starts in the chosen list (`selected` on the native option). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Cannot be moved; still posted when it starts chosen. |

### `TransferProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Required: the native select is `<id>-native`, the lists `<id>-source` / `<id>-target`. |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Posted once per chosen item (`<select multiple>`). |
| `options` | `TransferOption[]` | yes |  |
| `sourceTitle` | `string` |  | Heading of the available list. @default "Available" |
| `targetTitle` | `string` |  | Heading of the chosen list. @default "Chosen" |
| `searchable` | `boolean` |  | A search box above each list that filters its items. @default true |
| `searchPlaceholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `size` | `TransferSize` |  |  |
| `required` | `boolean` |  | At least one item must be chosen. |
| `requiredMessage` | `string` |  | Text for `required` (→ `data-msg-required` on the native select). |
| `emptyText` | `string` |  | Shown in a list with nothing in it. @default "Nothing here" |
| `noMatchText` | `string` |  | Shown when a search matches nothing. @default "No matches" |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### Pick the members of a team

The native `<select multiple name>` is what posts — one `members` value per chosen item — so a handler reads it like any multi select. transfer.js keeps it in step and fires `change` on it.

```ts
Transfer({
  id: "team-members",
  name: "members",
  sourceTitle: "Everyone",
  targetTitle: "On the team",
  options: [
    { value: "ada", label: "Ada Lovelace", selected: true },
    { value: "grace", label: "Grace Hopper" },
    { value: "margaret", label: "Margaret Hamilton" },
    { value: "ken", label: "Ken Thompson", disabled: true },
  ],
})
```

```html
<div class="transfer transfer--md" id="team-members" data-transfer="" data-validate-group="">
  <select class="transfer__native" id="team-members-native" name="members" multiple="" data-validate-proxy="#team-members-target" aria-label="On the team">
    <option value="ada" selected="">Ada Lovelace</option>
    <option value="grace">Grace Hopper</option>
    <option value="margaret">Margaret Hamilton</option>
    <option value="ken" disabled="">Ken Thompson</option>
  </select>
  <div class="transfer__ui">
    <div class="transfer__list" data-transfer-list="source">
      <div class="transfer__head">
        <span class="transfer__title" id="team-members-source-title">Everyone</span>
        <span class="transfer__count" data-transfer-count>3</span>
      </div>
      <input type="search" class="input input--sm transfer__search" data-transfer-search="" data-validate-skip="" form="team-members-search-scope" placeholder="Search" aria-label="Search everyone" autocomplete="off">
      <ul class="transfer__items" id="team-members-source" role="listbox" aria-multiselectable="true" aria-labelledby="team-members-source-title" tabindex="0">
        <li class="transfer__item" role="option" aria-selected="false" data-value="grace" data-index="1" tabindex="-1">
          <span class="transfer__check" aria-hidden="true">
            <svg width="14" height="14" width="2" …>…</svg>
          </span>
          <span class="transfer__label">Grace Hopper</span>
        </li>
        <li class="transfer__item" role="option" aria-selected="false" data-value="margaret" data-index="2" tabindex="-1">
          <span class="transfer__check" aria-hidden="true">
            <svg width="14" height="14" width="2" …>…</svg>
          </span>
          <span class="transfer__label">Margaret Hamilton</span>
        </li>
        <li class="transfer__item" role="option" aria-selected="false" aria-disabled="true" data-value="ken" data-index="3" tabindex="-1">
          <span class="transfer__check" aria-hidden="true">
            <svg width="14" height="14" width="2" …>…</svg>
          </span>
          <span class="transfer__label">Ken Thompson</span>
        </li>
      </ul>
      <p class="transfer__empty" data-transfer-empty data-empty-text="Nothing here" data-no-match-text="No matches" hidden>Nothing here</p>
    </div>
    <div class="transfer__controls" role="group" aria-label="Move items">
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--outline btn--sm btn--icon transfer__move" data-transfer-move="all-to-target" aria-label="Move all to chosen" title="Move all to chosen">
        <svg width="16" height="16" width="2" …>…</svg>
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--outline btn--sm btn--icon transfer__move" data-transfer-move="to-target" aria-label="Move selected to chosen" title="Move selected to chosen">
        <svg width="16" height="16" width="2" …>…</svg>
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--outline btn--sm btn--icon transfer__move" data-transfer-move="to-source" aria-label="Move selected to available" title="Move selected to available">
        <svg width="16" height="16" width="2" …>…</svg>
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--outline btn--sm btn--icon transfer__move" data-transfer-move="all-to-source" aria-label="Move all to available" title="Move all to available">
        <svg width="16" height="16" width="2" …>…</svg>
      </button>
    </div>
    <div class="transfer__list" data-transfer-list="target">
      <div class="transfer__head">
        <span class="transfer__title" id="team-members-target-title">On the team</span>
        <span class="transfer__count" data-transfer-count>1</span>
      </div>
      <input type="search" class="input input--sm transfer__search" data-transfer-search="" data-validate-skip="" form="team-members-search-scope" placeholder="Search" aria-label="Search on the team" autocomplete="off">
      <ul class="transfer__items" id="team-members-target" role="listbox" aria-multiselectable="true" aria-labelledby="team-members-target-title" tabindex="0">
        <li class="transfer__item" role="option" aria-selected="false" data-value="ada" data-index="0" tabindex="-1">
          <span class="transfer__check" aria-hidden="true">
            <svg width="14" height="14" width="2" …>…</svg>
          </span>
          <span class="transfer__label">Ada Lovelace</span>
        </li>
      </ul>
```

### Short lists: no search box, at least one required

`required` is reported on the chosen list by `Form({ validate })` and by the browser in a plain form.

```ts
Transfer({
  id: "regions",
  name: "regions",
  size: "sm",
  searchable: false,
  required: true,
  requiredMessage: "Pick at least one region.",
  options: [
    { value: "eu", label: "Europe" },
    { value: "us", label: "North America" },
    { value: "apac", label: "Asia-Pacific" },
  ],
})
```

## CSS hooks

Classes defined by `components/transfer/transfer.css` — structural, token-driven; override from an unlayered stylesheet (see [Theming](../UI-Theming.md)):

`.js`, `.transfer`, `.transfer--lg`, `.transfer--sm`, `.transfer__check`, `.transfer__controls`, `.transfer__count`, `.transfer__empty`, `.transfer__head`, `.transfer__item`, `.transfer__items`, `.transfer__label`, `.transfer__list`, `.transfer__move`, `.transfer__native`, `.transfer__search`, `.transfer__title`, `.transfer__ui`

## Behaviour

`components/transfer/transfer.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-empty-text`, `data-index`, `data-no-match-text`, `data-transfer`, `data-transfer-count`, `data-transfer-disabled`, `data-transfer-empty`, `data-transfer-list`, `data-transfer-move`, `data-transfer-ready`, `data-transfer-search`, `data-value`.

Events: `rapid:swapped`, `transfer:change`.
